title: close: a green non-dry-run close sets the lane terminal
action: R2. `close_handler` (close.rs:1485) already retires the feature's cells and auto-commits .bee bookkeeping on a green close, but writes NO phase — so a fully closed feature keeps reading `swarming`/`planning` forever. Fix: at the very tail of the GREEN path — after `commit_close_bookkeeping` (close.rs:1931-1947), before the final `lines.push("next: done …")`/`Ok(Out::Emit(...))` at close.rs:1949-1953 — set the feature's lane phase to the terminal value `idle`, with a next_action naming that the feature closed. Reuse the existing internal setter `run_set_body` (set_gate.rs:318, root+flags-parameterized, already called directly by ~20 tests) rather than shelling out or hand-writing the record: it enforces the --owner precondition and the phase enum for free, and pass --owner equal to the record's own pre-mutation phase read at that moment. Write `idle`, NEVER `compounding-complete` — that value is gated on a fresh recorded compounding run (store.rs:235-281) and close has no standing to waive it. Guards: --dry-run writes nothing; any BLOCKING door writes nothing (the write sits past every refusal by construction); a lane already at a terminal phase is left alone; the write is best-effort like the bookkeeping commit beside it — a failure warns on its own line and the close stays green. Add one line to the emitted text naming the new phase.
done_when: A green non-dry-run `bee close --feature <f>` leaves .bee/lanes/<f>.json at phase 'idle' with a next_action naming the close; `--dry-run` leaves the phase untouched; a close blocked by any door leaves the phase untouched; a lane already terminal is not rewritten; a failing phase write warns and the close still exits 0; existing close tests still pass.
notes: Phase 3. Independent of mcl-2 — single file, no overlap. Runs in parallel with mcl-2 once mcl-1 lands.

truths: A green non-dry-run `bee close --feature <f>` leaves .bee/lanes/<f>.json at phase 'idle' with a next_action naming the close.
`bee close --feature <f> --dry-run` leaves the lane record byte-identical.
A close stopped by any BLOCKING door leaves the lane record byte-identical.
A lane already at a terminal phase ('idle' or 'compounding-complete') is not rewritten.
A failing phase write emits a warning line and the close still exits 0.

report.outcome: Green non-dry-run close now sets the feature lane to phase idle with a next_action naming the close, reusing run_set_body for the owner/enum guard; dry-run, blocked closes, and already-terminal lanes are left untouched, and a failing write warns without failing the close.

All eight blocking doors return before close.rs:1949 with exit 1; no door exists after the write. Test a_close_blocked_by_a_door_leaves_the_lane_record_byte_identical compares raw bytes.
